repos_data.description: MCP server for OpenAI and Gemini Deep Research, Tavily Research, and self-hosted DR-Tulu and openJiuwen DeepSearch (Gnosis).

SERPdive MCP server: real-time web search with answer-ready results for Claude, Cursor and any MCP client. A Tavily alternative: same speed, 20.2% fewer tokens, higher answer quality (60.7% of decided duels). Hosted at mcp.serpdive.com or npx serpdive-mcp.
